interactions.summary: Carol reads the start of Bonaventure's praise of Dominic as one of the two champions sent to revive the Church, with some heavy ASR degradation near the transition lines.
Jiang briefly interprets the canto's pairing by saying Francis married poverty while Dominic will be paired with faith.
The reading shifts into Dominic's birth and vocation, and Jiang uses it as the setup for a historical explanation of the Dominican order's militant educational role against heresy.

speaker_notes.note: These segments are quoted reading. Several names and clauses are garbled by ASR, so Jiang's short interpretive glosses are more reliable than the raw wording for semantic extraction.

claims.claim: Jiang says the two champions named in the canto are Francis and Dominic.
He frames the symbolic pairing as Francis marrying poverty while Dominic marries faith.
The quoted canto presents Dominic as a loving servant of Christian faith and as a figure born to defend and revive the Church.

signature_moments.moment: Jiang compresses the new symbolic pairing into a marriage formula: Francis weds poverty, Dominic weds faith.
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It gives the Dominican section its governing contrast and makes the order legible in the same allegorical grammar as Francis.

signature_moments.moment: The canto casts Francis and Dominic as a paired rescue force sent to revive the Church when its own bride is in danger.
signature_moments.source_phrase: the two champions are francis and dominic
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It preserves the packet's core image of the two orders as complementary remedies for ecclesial crisis.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: Jiang's identification of Francis and Dominic as the paired defenders sent to revive the Church.
Jiang's shorthand for Dominic's symbolic vocation, parallel to Francis's marriage to poverty.

chronology_notes.note: On 2026-06-17 the seminar pivots from Franciscan corruption to Bonaventure's introduction of Dominic, with Jiang establishing the symbolic contrast that will anchor the historical account of the Dominican order.

uncertainty_notes.note: Several quoted lines and proper names are badly degraded by ASR, so the semantic pass should keep close to the broad function of the passage rather than overclaim exact wording or biographical detail from the raw read-aloud text.
